verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents automation artifacts (skills, hooks, scheduled tasks) and a project-root CLAUDE.md file. It also documents general git operations. However, nothing in the pack shows a first-party way to version, review, or roll back automations themselves. Putting files in a repo and managing them with git is a user-side workaround built on a separate tool, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
